historical.source1991: NEN 6743:1991 / NEN 6740:1991; public reference 05290 pp. 31–32 (single precast pile)
historical.source2012: NEN 9997-1:2011+C1:2012 table 7.c; original factors before reduction
historical.conditions: Historical compression pile model: sand; no pile group, OCR, grain size or excavation correction. Shaft peaks conservatively capped at 12 MPa. Settlement not verified.

steel-pipe-driven-closed.name: Steel tube pile — driven (existing project model)
steel-pipe-driven-closed.conditions: Existing factor set retained; deviates from table 7.c:2017 for closed-end steel tube piles.
steel-pipe-driven-closed.source: Existing calculation model and reference report 984.pdf

steel-pipe-driven-closed-2017.name: Steel tube pile — closed end (2017 table)
steel-pipe-driven-closed-2017.conditions: Base plate protrudes at most 10 mm beyond the tube; concrete-filled tube.

concrete-driven-casing-hammered.name: Cast-in-place concrete pile — casing extracted by back-driving
concrete-driven-casing-hammered.conditions: Concrete bears directly against the soil; casing extracted by back-driving and static pulling.

concrete-driven-casing-vibrated.name: Cast-in-place concrete pile — casing extracted by vibration
concrete-driven-casing-vibrated.conditions: Concrete bears directly against the soil; casing extracted by vibration and static pulling.

concrete-screw-displacement.name: Concrete screw pile — lost tip
concrete-screw-displacement.conditions: Smooth casing withdrawn; concrete bears directly against the soil.

steel-screw-grout.name: Steel screw pile — grout injection
steel-screw-grout.conditions: Grout shaft ≥ 300 mm; do not move up and down during installation. EA refers to the steel/core, not the grout shaft surface.

concrete-auger.name: Auger pile — concrete
concrete-auger.conditions: 2017 edition: start of qc;III capped at 2 MPa; no exemption based on post-installation CPTs applied.

timber-uniform.name: Timber driven pile — round, with or without concrete extension
timber-uniform.conditions: Round timber cross-section, constant or linearly tapered from the top of the timber; optionally with a concrete extension down to the joint. No increase of pile factors for taper.
